title: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling: I felt like I was really clicking with the offense

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling: I felt like I was really clicking with the offense
sources.description: Many 49ers who are expected to play roles for the team this fall did not play on Thursday night, but rookie wide receiver De'Zhaun Stribling was on the field and the second-round pick took advantage of the opportunity.
